blocks.text: LUCENA CITY, Quezon— The provincial government of Batangas is stepping up preparations to mitigate the potential effects of “super” El Niño on agriculture, livestock, public health and other sectors in the coming months. According to a report released Wednesday by the Batangas Public Information Office (PIO), representatives of the Provincial El Niño Technical Working Group met on Oct. 20 upon the directive of Gov. Vilma Santos-Recto to discuss programs and interventions to address the threat of prolonged drought.
